steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: We've completed our analysis of those things. Their function is very similar to your own ability. EDGE has accelerated development. The first batch of operational gear is ready, the operators are in training, and the new tactical framework is almost finalized.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: The team is composed of volunteers. All of them are elite soldiers. High skill, higher morale. That won't be a problem.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: Now, it's your turn.
Catherine reviews the plan.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: And this is how you plan to stop the second nuke?

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: We still have you, don't we?

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: What, with my little spoon-bending party trick?

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: That "trick" is how we win.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: You expect me to fight a nuclear weapon?

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: Getting cold feet? I thought you'd outgrown the idea that a nuke is the ultimate power.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Still trying to sweet-talk me? I know a gamble when I see one.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: ...But fine. I'll admit it, your conviction is real this time.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: You're not hiding anything else, are you? This plan... it's everything from the deduction?
Dravyn broke into a smile.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: I omitted one detail: the probability of your death. In front of Brock, I can't lie. Anyone can lose their life on the battlefield.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: But I still need you for this battle.
He extended his right hand, his expression remaining calm. Catherine tilted her head, as if contemplating something.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: Fight for us, Catherine Augustus Andohar. You were born a warrior. Now become DisCity's sword.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: Your enemy isn't the metropoles. It's the war—the fate you've learned to hate.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: I will give you a weapon powerful enough to break it. And a glorious victory.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: It will be a battlefield worthy of you.
Catherine nodded, reaching out her right hand to pat Dravyn.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: ...Of course you will. This is my debut, after all. Don't you dare screw it up.
[Battle Report] Operation Skyfall

N.F. 68/10/06 03:45:01
EDGE completed the first implementation test of the Reaper-series equipment. Detailed tactical models were finalized at 04:00 on the 7th.
N.F. 68/10/07 05:12 to 05:30
Command convened an operation briefing and distributed mission plans. Simultaneously, Major Dravyn obtained agreement from the operation's linchpin, <color=#fb9259>Catherine Andohar</color>.
N.F. 68/10/07 06:39:56
Catherine officially entered the operation sequence. Dravyn issued authorization documents, codename R.A.-Zeroth. <color=#fb9259><u>[Operation Skyfall]</u></color>, aimed at overthrowing the world's most powerful force, was officially launched.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: Units 4 and 5 in position. Ready to initiate resonance conduction on your mark.

N.F. 68/10/07 08:17:15
Vennon piloted the C4-N fighter aircraft with Catherine aboard, reaching high altitude. Wind speed was 15 knots; weather conditions were stable.
N.F. 68/10/07 09:19:42
Reaper Prototype Wielders #1-68 completed distributed deployment. Magnetic pole calibration and band synchronization were finalized. Relative deviation was contained within ±1.4%.
N.F. 68/10/07 09:20:19
The primary magnetic field manipulator, <color=#fb9259>Catherine Augustus Andohar</color>, completed final synchronization with the remaining Reaper wielders. The target warhead was scheduled to enter interference range in 2 minutes.
<color=#fb9259><u>[Operation Skyfall]</u></color> entered the active combat phase.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: Alright, Catherine, you're up. The Reapers are in position. Now go show them what you've got and bring us a big win. I've got you covered.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: When we go back, you'll be the youngest general in DisCity's history.

N.F. 68/10/07 09:21:52
Aircraft squadrons arrived at the designated combat airspace in waves, forming an encirclement formation. Enemy warhead was confirmed at the maximum range of the magnetic capture zone.
N.F. 68/10/07 09:22:19
Enemy nuclear warhead entered the early warning response area. Magnetic field resonance was activated at maximum power. The initial trajectory deviation of the nuclear warhead was detected.

Her heart racing, the 14-year-old gripped the red crystal flower that bloomed in Vennon's hand. She could feel the magnetic fields around her—one after another—converging and interweaving at the center.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: ...One... Two... Three...

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: None of you are getting away!

N.F. 68/10/07 09:23:30
Target warhead was controlled to crash in the designated WhiteSands buffer zone. The original nuclear targets—primary target DisCity and secondary target Nirvana Port—remained undamaged.
N.F. 68/10/07 09:29:58
All combat units completed their return. Some Reaper equipment was damaged. Five test operators were lost in action.
N.F. 68/10/07 09:35:00
<color=#fb9259>Catherine Andohar</color> successfully completed her first mission and was confirmed safe and unharmed. Major Dravyn issued on-site verification. <color=#fb9259><u>[Operation Skyfall]</u></color> and Reaper equipment data were classified under the highest security clearance in the Independence Army archives.
